businesses.business: oilfield wellhead and pressure control equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures wellheads and well completion equipment, notably the SafeDrill wellhead and frac-related pressure control equipment, for oil and gas operators and pressure pumpers. Also rents and services spoolable pipe and surface equipment at the well site. Manufactures in company-owned facilities.

primary_products.value: wellheads; frac pressure control equipment; spoolable pipe; spare parts

primary_services.value: equipment rental; field service and repair; wellsite installation support

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators, pressure pumping service companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; hydraulic fracturing; well completions

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rental of wellhead and pressure control equipment per job; product sales: wellheads and spoolable pipe sold to operators; service fees: field service, installation, and repair
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds wellheads and pressure control equipment from purchased steel and components, sold to operators and pressure pumpers; asset operator: owns rental fleet of wellheads and spoolable pipe deployed at customer well sites

geography_served.value: North America: US basins such as Permian, plus Canada and some Australia operations

specialization.value: related lines: wellheads, spoolable pipe, and related rental and service for well completions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales and field service teams serving operators and pressure pumpers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: oilfield equipment standards such as API specifications, plus environmental and workplace safety rules

notes: International footprint details (Australia) are less certain.
